topic: Vietnam's meat imports in 2025, total and from India
claim_a: Customs via the Department of Import and Export: 978.3 kt, USD 2.004 billion; India 188.7 kt, USD 681.32 million (MIM-04; MIM-05)
claim_b: MAE figures via VnEconomy: about USD 1.95 billion; India 168 kt, USD 601.8 million (MIM-07)
position_taken: Use the customs figures; the MAE figure was published earlier (13 Jan 2026) and is probably preliminary or for 11 months

claim_a: Customs basis: about 16.5% (about 360 kt of poultry meat and by-products against about 1,821 kt domestic carcass; our calculation from MIM-05 and MAC-14)
claim_b: USDA PSD: 11.0% of chicken consumption (175 / 1,595 kt) (MIM-03); OECD-FAO: 12.5% (self-sufficiency 87.5%, QNT-01)
position_taken: Report both by definition: 11 to 12.5% for chicken meat, about 16.5% including feet, offal and spent hens. Keep OECD-FAO in the balance model
notes: Definitions differ (by-products and spent hens are in the customs group).

topic: Share of beef and buffalo meat consumption imported, 2025
position_taken: Give the range 32 to 48%; keep OECD-FAO in the balance model; flag onward trade of Indian buffalo meat as a reason both may overstate what is eaten
notes: Open question on onward trade to China.

claim_a: Vietnamese customs: 188.7 kt of meat from India (MIM-04)
claim_b: India-reported exports to Vietnam: 170,561 t frozen bovine meat plus 51,759 t offal, 222.3 kt (MIM-02); Tuoi Tre: about 300,000 t a year (MIM-28)
position_taken: Use Vietnamese customs for Vietnamese imports; the gap may be shipments routed through Vietnam that never enter its customs records
notes: Tuoi Tre's source for 300,000 t is not clear.

claim_a: Vietnamese customs: 48.44% of 183.4 kt of pork imports, about 88.8 kt (our calculation from MIM-06)
claim_b: Russian veterinary system (VetIS): 52,300 t of pork to Vietnam (MIM-19)
position_taken: Use Vietnamese customs; the gap is unexplained (probably product coverage, such as by-products counted as pork in Vietnam)

topic: Tonnage of Vietnam's meat imports in Comtrade, 2023
claim_a: Vietnam-reported: Indian frozen bovine meat 75,537 t; US poultry 54,382 t (MIM-01)
claim_b: Exporter-reported: India 192,180 t; United States 117,694 t, at similar values (MIM-02)
position_taken: Do not use Vietnam-reported Comtrade weights; use values, customs tonnages and mirror tonnages
notes: Implied Vietnam-reported unit values (USD 6.5 per kg for buffalo meat) are implausible.

claim_a: USDA PSD forecast: 120 kt CWE, down from 151 kt in 2025 (MIM-03)
claim_b: Customs: 112,090 t in January to July 2026, up 27.1% (MIM-09; MIM-10); press: 'over 300,000 t' (no named forecaster, MIM-06)
position_taken: Follow the revealed customs trend; adopt neither forecast
notes: USDA's April 2026 forecast predates the 2026 surge.
